data.long_meaning: The name Ajya is recorded with the meaning “Knowledgeable”. Ajya is a Hindu name meaning “Knowledgeable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_hindi.name: Ajya
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Knowledgeable
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ajya एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The one who is full of knowledge and wisdom.

in_tamil.name: Ajya
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ajya ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। The one who is full of knowledge and wisdom.

in_telugu.name: Ajya
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ajya ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। The one who is full of knowledge and wisdom.

in_marathi.name: Ajya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is full of knowledge and wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Ajya
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ajya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is full of knowledge and wisdom.
